# Sandbox tables (generated by scripts/tables.py)

Test = BrainBench v0.2 world s2; label pool = worlds s1 (+ s3 for J1). 95% CIs: cluster bootstrap over test groups (tasks for J2/J3, entities for J1). AUROC-err = how well (1 − confidence) ranks the model's own wrong answers (0.5 = useless). Latency = batch-1 p50 on 1 contended vCPU, fp32.
